name: sections
label: Sections
description: The song section finder: on a library entry's bar grid it reads per-bar stem activity, chroma, loudness and spectral novelty, finds boundaries by novelty and repetition (self-similarity), labels sections with repeat letters (A, B, A') and roles (intro, verse, chorus, drop, break, bridge, outro) with a confidence per boundary, stores them per entry with the user's names, and fills the Shard Index's section field. numpy + librosa, no model.
